title: Figures 15-16: CFD pressure and temperature contours around Tic Tac UAP at 700 mph
description: Two computational fluid dynamics contour plots of the Tic Tac UAP model at 1/6 scale, air temperature 223K and 700 mph with mixed inlet and supersonic outlet. Figure 15 shows the pressure field in Pascals with a bow compression at the nose; Figure 16 shows the temperature field in Kelvin with a heated wake trailing the body. Color scale legends at right.
